comparison.objective: Press a head-restraint release while pulling the restraint out; candidate adjusts and locks a gripper stop.
comparison.physical_skill: Simultaneous release-button holding and axial extraction versus simultaneous rotational counterholding and nut tightening.
comparison.success_condition: Restraint removed without breaking the lock and placed in a box versus angle preserved, nuts retained, and cycles repeatable.
comparison.reason: Shared bimanual coordination is generic; release-and-extract and torque-preserved adjustment are different mechanisms.
